MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Court Trial/Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 514, Judge: Judge: Donald J. Sullivan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong #11288.
Thomass Jones, Esq. appeared for plaintiff Muse, Inc.

Plaintiff Witness Jacek Rosicki, was placed under oath and direct examined.
No appearance by Defaulted Defendant(s): Joseph Bretz and David L. Blackford.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendant(s) as follows:

Damages/Principal - $325,000.00
Prejudgment Interest - $7,809.00
Attorney's Fees - none
Costs - $724.200, for a total judgment in the amount of $333,533.20

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
